summary: Verified 4 voice-assistant fixes. Fix 1 (GA SDP endpoint) PASSES at runtime — POST https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime/calls?model=gpt-realtime returned HTTP 201 (was 400). Fix 2 (marin voice) source-verified. Fix 3 (query_dashboard) — backend endpoint /api/voice/query works perfectly (10/10 pytest, live data returned), client tool schema + handler + system prompt all source-verified, BUT runtime tool registration is REJECTED by OpenAI with 'Missing required parameter: session.type'. Fix 4 (response.cancelled handling) source-verified in use-realtime-voice.ts:239-256.

integration_issues.flow: Voice Orb — tool registration on data-channel open
integration_issues.issue: The session.update sent from dc.onopen in frontend/src/hooks/use-realtime-voice.ts (lines 442-517) omits session.type. OpenAI GA Realtime API rejects it with invalid_request_error: 'Missing required parameter: session.type' (captured live). Consequence: fill_form AND query_dashboard tools are never registered on the session, so the model can never call query_dashboard — Fix 3 is unreachable at runtime until this is patched. Add session.type: 'realtime' inside the session object.

action_items: PATCH: Add `type: 'realtime'` to the session object in the session.update payload at frontend/src/hooks/use-realtime-voice.ts:445 (inside dc.onopen). Without this, fill_form and query_dashboard tools are never registered and Fix 3 cannot complete E2E.

After patching, re-run voice orb flow — expect NO 'server error' event on connect, and expect the model to emit response.function_call_arguments.done with name='query_dashboard' when asked 'kitne shipments pending hain?'.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the tool-registration failure: OpenAI GA Realtime API tightened session.update validation — the outer 'session' object now requires a 'type' discriminator (same 'realtime' value that /realtime-token uses at server.py:2445). The client's session.update at use-realtime-voice.ts:445-515 only sends tools + tool_choice. Reproduction: log in, click voice orb, watch DevTools console — immediately after 'listening' state you see one 'realtime server error' event with error.param='session.type'. Mitigation: add `type: 'realtime'` next to `tools:` inside the session object; no other code change needed.
